entries.headline: SPAR20 C-40C sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing C-40C registration 05-0932, call sign SPAR20 and hex AE189C. The sighting was credited to reagan0965, with a photograph credited to Elias Dieckert via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: European flight bomb-threat disruptions reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Insider Paper report that bomb threats had disrupted flights in Europe. The report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: INDY81 KC-135 Stratotanker sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing KC-135R/T Stratotanker registration 60-0364, call sign INDY81 and hex AE0663. The sighting was credited to reagan0965, with a photograph credited to Connor Ochs via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Greenland parliament security-deal report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Insider Paper report that Greenland’s parliament had ratified a security deal with the United States. The report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: UKMTO tanker warning report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations Centre issued a warning after a company security officer reported that a tanker was involved in an unspecified situation. The visible text is truncated immediately after “was” and does not show what was reported. The report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: German military-dominance comment relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Polymarket Intel report quoting German deputy defence minister Nils Schmid as saying Germany’s neighbours had no reason to fear a militarily dominant Germany. The report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Drone-focused warship concept report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Reuters report that Naval Group had unveiled a drone-focused warship concept. It said the report preceded wire coverage by 63 minutes and was confirmed by two outlets.

entries.headline: Iran chemical-weapons intelligence report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report that Israel had shared intelligence with the United States indicating Iran was planning to use chemical weapons against Tel Aviv. The visible text is truncated immediately after “according to” and does not identify the cited source. The report was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: ADFEB5 E-4B sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing E-4B registration 74-0787 and hex ADFEB5, with no call sign shown. The sighting was credited to reagan0965, with a photograph credited to Chris Lofting via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: U.S., Gulf and Baltic air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. military surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States, Gulf air activity at nearly three times normal with elevated coded radio traffic, and busy activity in the Baltic.

entries.headline: GRUMN11 E-2 Hawkeye sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of an E-2 Hawkeye using call sign GRUMN11 and hex AFA186, with no registration shown. The sighting was credited to JessiDavin.

entries.headline: Yemeni foreign-experts report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report quoting Yemen’s interior minister as saying there were 21 foreign experts, including 14 from the Revolutionary Guard. The visible text is truncated immediately after “Revolutionary” and does not show the remainder of the report. It said the report preceded wire coverage by 25 minutes and was confirmed by two outlets.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: SCORE90 Global Hawk sighting reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported tracking SCORE90, a Northrop Grumman Global Hawk (Q4), off the Mid-Atlantic coast. It said the aircraft was spotted at about 49,900 feet at 2:44 p.m. ET on 3 November and last seen around 3:01 p.m. about nine miles east-southeast of Ocean City, Maryland.

entries.headline: NTSB weather focus in Sunday crash relayed
entries.summary: SkyGlass relayed comments from its founder about air-traffic-control audio from Sunday's crash and said the audio would not be shared out of respect. It reported that the NTSB was focusing on weather and offered condolences to those affected.

entries.headline: NetJets and Flexjet activity growth reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported tracked NetJets and Flexjet activity up 11.0% in October 2026 from October 2025, while full-service Jet A rose from $7.50 to $7.86. It said fractional flying did not slow and that the figures were pulled with the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: N722BD Learjet 60 crash reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Learjet 60 N722BD, flying from Austin to North Eleuthera, crashed near Military Trail in Palm Beach County on Sunday afternoon, killing all nine people aboard. It said the NTSB was investigating and shared an AVIAR Labs Overwatch replay.

entries.headline: Signature Access FBO pricing changes examined
entries.summary: SkyGlass said Signature Access prices core fixed-base-operator access by aircraft size, ramp time and location, while limiting event fees from 2027. It argued that ramp dwell time and demand are operational variables FBOs should track, citing RampWatch as a way to show them.

entries.headline: BACE2026 four-field business-jet total revisited
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that 1,040 distinct business jets moved through four Las Vegas fields during BACE2026 show week. It said the RampWatch board prompted conversations, including direct-message feedback that ramp personnel wanted views of their own traffic, and linked to a replay.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.
